newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesias's Suharto conducting business as usual.
newsitem.headline: Indonesias's Suharto conducting business as usual.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto was in good health and conducting business as usual on Thursday, palace officials said.
"He is fine and is fulfilling his schedule," an official told Reuters.

They were commenting on rumours on the foreign exchange market that he had been admitted to hospital. The Indonesian rupiah fell to a low of 2,325 to the dollar from an early levelm of 2,317 before stabilising at 2,321.
